result.instructions: VRoid Studio MCP. Tool names and arguments are English. Call vroid_help('overview') before a complex task; vroid_help supports lang=en|fr|ja|zh-CN. VRoid Studio must be running with the bridge loaded. Only one model can be open at a time. Call vroid_status first. Save before vroid_main_menu, vroid_open or vroid_create. For visual work, use vroid_screenshot. For preset discovery, use vroid_preset_cache_search before applying presets. For sequences, use vroid_batch (up to 200 sequential operations, no automatic rollback). Do not assume that one preset replaces only one slot: whole outfits can replace several slots; verify with vroid_list_groups. Thumbnail generation strips all clothes, underwear and hair except the tested item. An English Agent Reference is exposed as MCP resources: vroid://agent/reference (full), plus vroid://agent/start, face, hairstyle, body, outfit, accessories, look, physical, presets, tools, workflows and troubleshooting. Read only the section needed; tools/list stays the authoritative schema list. MCP prompts: start (open a working session), character (build a character from a description), export_vrm (full/balanced/light VRM export), help. Reply in the user's language; never overwrite the user's .vroid file or discard changes without asking.
